# Each object is the whole figure in the grid. The output turns it a half turn, 180 degrees, about the grid center
class Obj(x: int, y: int, width: int, height: int, orientation: int, volume: int):
    this.x is x
    this.y is y
    this.width is width
    this.height is height
    this.orientation is orientation
    this.volume is volume
    this.tag is l9100

# Each figure turns 180 degrees from its input orientation
$Obj.orientation is ($Obj.orientation@first + 180) % 360

# The half turn moves its box to the mirrored column: as far from the right edge as it was from the left
$Obj.x is canvas_width - $Obj.x@first - $Obj.width

# The half turn moves its box to the mirrored row: as far from the bottom edge as it was from the top
$Obj.y is canvas_height - $Obj.y@first - $Obj.height
